sections.name: Wild Duel
sections.description_summary: targets enemy with highest cumulative damage, dashes and kicks them twice, then enters a 12 s duel; both prioritize attacking each other. Kicks can stun; Lenya is unaffected while kicking.

sections.name: Tornado Strike
sections.description_summary: passive blocks a normal attack from current target within 1 tile and retaliates with a damaging stun. Active: tornado kick damages surrounding enemies.

sections.name: Flurry Kicks
sections.description_summary: gains Crit; critical normal attacks trigger a power kick that damages and stuns.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Haste.

sections.name: Winning Resolve
sections.description_summary: during a duel, increases Crit DMG Boost and ATK; Flurry Kicks becomes a multi-hit super kick. Winning duel extends full-potential duration.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: reduces damage taken from enemies other than duel target. LV 2 grants opening shield, Crit and Crit DMG Boost; casting Ultimate increases shield; winning duel restores Energy.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: critical-hit splash damage; higher ranks convert part of critical damage into a permanent shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: separate opening/assist/defeat stats and refine effects.

sections.name: Explode, my chariot!
sections.description_summary: Damian cannot be attacked and builds a toy chariot that inherits his stats. Active: sends chariot at target to explode, damage and blind nearby enemies; restores Energy based on chariot HP. If absent, builds a new one.

sections.name: Emergency Support!
sections.description_summary: heals weakest ally near chariot repeatedly; if no chariot, restores Damian's Energy.

sections.name: It's a Plane!
sections.description_summary: sends toy plane toward farthest enemy, damaging and stunning them.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: ATK.

sections.name: Inventor's Will

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: increases blind duration when chariot HP is above 50%. LV 2 expands Emergency Support! healing to entire battlefield and adds another ally.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: healing an ally increases their ATK for 8 s; higher ranks add Healing after cumulative-healing threshold.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: separate first-low-HP ally heal/shield and refine stats.

sections.name: Relentless Chase

sections.name: Forest's Wrath
sections.description_summary: Forest Mark reduces Phys DEF. When marked enemy is defeated, Kafra and nearby allies heal repeatedly for a short duration.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: ATK.

sections.name: Sylvan Banishment

sections.name: Enhance Force

sections.name: Season Charm

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: separate timed defensive/offensive effect and refine stats.

sections.name: Quake Slam
sections.description_summary: targets adjacent enemy or enemy nearer allied backline; knocks airborne then slams, damaging target and adjacent enemies and stunning them. Lucca is control-immune while casting.

sections.name: Ruthless Ram
sections.description_summary: gains a shield based on Phys DEF and Magic DEF, then shoulders into an enemy, interrupting and disarming them.
